_doc: Plan 075: login-rule SUGGESTION patterns over official notice text (plan 064 Detail reads). A notice is considered only when `gate` matches somewhere in its text; lines matching `weekend` feed only weekend rules. Each rule: field (days_needed | min_minutes | weekend_minutes), re (case-insensitive, named group n = a number or a word from `numbers`), scale (multiplier: 7 for weeks, 60 for hours). First match per field wins. The result is only ever SUGGESTED (one click to track); notice counts are worded loosely, so it is never auto-applied.
